confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and budget-hostel anchors are more reliable than accommodation at the 3-star level. Alcohol availability and pricing in Varanasi are uncertain, so beer, cocktail and wine anchors are lower confidence. Cocktail was set at about 2x the beer anchor, and wine was set from typical restaurant markups on imported wine, since direct knowledge of local prices is weak. The FX value is the RBA observation for 2026-10-15 as reported in search results; I did not open the RBA page directly in this run, and I did not use an unverified later third-party figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other North Indian heritage and pilgrimage cities with similar tourist price levels, such as Agra and Jaipur, adjusted for Varanasi's lower hotel tiers and more limited alcohol service.
